headline: Bitcoin Pulls Back Amid Cautiousness Over AI and US Interest Rate Outlook
summary: Bitcoin declined as investors exercised caution regarding artificial intelligence valuations and the prospect of higher US interest rates, while its correlation with US equities increased.
why: Cryptocurrency prices remain sensitive to shifting macroeconomic liquidity conditions, interest rate expectations, and broader risk sentiment in global equity markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin prices dropped due to macroeconomic caution and interest rate concerns.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Cautious sentiment regarding potential US interest rate hikes and broader market worries over technology valuations drove a pullback in digital asset prices.
